injury_predictions.name: De'Von Achane
injury_predictions.note: Torn ACL in Week 3 loss to KC, confirmed by MRI Monday; placed on IR. Out for the season.

injury_predictions.name: Josh Jacobs
injury_predictions.note: Pleaded no contest Sept 10 (criminal case resolved). Remains on Commissioner's Exempt List (paid, can't play/practice); NFL confirms no timetable for discipline. Standard domestic-violence-case suspension is 6 games, could be shorter or longer.

injury_predictions.name: Zach Charbonnet
injury_predictions.note: Reserve/PUP (ACL, Jan 17). Macdonald (9/23): Seattle will NOT open his practice window this week, 'closing in on a decision'. Eligible for Week 5 but needs a practice ramp first, so Week 5 is unlikely; Week 6 is the earliest realistic game. PFN analyst guesses Week 8 (opinion, not reported).
injury_predictions.source: Mike Macdonald via RotoWire (9/23), Pro Football Network

injury_predictions.name: A.J. Brown
injury_predictions.note: On IR, high-ankle sprain. Week 6 (vs NYJ) was the earliest eligible date, but Rapoport (9/22): 'the expectation is he misses six weeks' - Patriots determined the injury is more serious than the initial 4-6 wk range suggested. Realistic return is Week 8 vs MIA.

injury_predictions.name: Caleb Williams
injury_predictions.note: Grade 2 hamstring strain suffered Week 2 vs MIN; ruled out Week 3 (Keenum starting). Schefter/Rapoport: 3-4 week timeline, so Week 5 at the earliest (Bears call him a quick healer), Week 6 more likely.
injury_predictions.source: Adam Schefter & Ian Rapoport via ESPN, ChicagoBears.com

injury_predictions.name: Jayden Daniels
injury_predictions.note: Dislocated left elbow in Week 2 vs DAL. No surgery, no IR (GM Adam Peters, 9/25). Rapoport (9/27): expected back within three weeks, playing in a brace. Week 5 possible, Week 6 most likely.
injury_predictions.source: Ian Rapoport (NFL Network), Adam Peters, CBS Sports

injury_predictions.name: Jordyn Tyson
injury_predictions.note: IR (designated to return), right hamstring strain suffered ~Aug 18; NFL Network reported ~2 months out, and Saints are being cautious given his 4th hamstring injury. Week 5 is the earliest eligible date; ~8 weeks points to Week 6.

injury_predictions.name: Travis Etienne
injury_predictions.note: Hamstring injury in Week 3 loss to LV. Kellen Moore (Mon): will have 'time lost', no timeline given; unclear if IR. Out for Week 4 (MNF at ATL) assumed; if he goes to IR, bump to Week 8.
injury_predictions.source: Kellen Moore via ESPN, NBC Sports (PFT)

injury_predictions.name: Jordan Mason
injury_predictions.note: IR, fractured thumb, had surgery. Coach O'Connell: expects him back at the 4-week IR minimum, not longer. Aaron Jones is now Minnesota's clear lead back - Mason projects as a backup/change-of-pace role even once healthy, not a lead job.
